notes.title: SUMMER STORIES: THE FINALE
notes.content:
Hey there, friends!

It's time for a final round of sketches for the summer update. The artists have picked up their pens and are rendering the stories like crazy. Let's wish them the best!

Now, let's dive into the rest of the stories!

Ricky and Roxana are still exploring each other in their relationship. Ricky’s job is tied to dolphins, and Roxana is very interested in seeing what Ricky does for a living. And meet the dolphins! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/faf45a45fc10a39f3541f2a717b8d3ef2cf70327.jpg[/img]

Besides, Ricky is more than happy to show Roxana the world and even more. Will he be able to impress his girlfriend with his true love of the sea?

notes.title: WE'RE ALMOST THERE!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

We're counting down the hours to the release - the game got approved, and we can't wait to show you the final result of our work. Not gonna lie, it's been fun to once again revise the beloved characters and create new ones. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221840/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_3_Come_Inside_Sweety/

[h2]So... What now? [/h2]

Right now we're focused on polishing the release build of the game and planning the items for the point shop update. New animated backgrounds, fun stickers and emojis, mini profiles - anything you can imagine is going to be there. We hope you will give our new girls lots of love and care, so we can see who you like the most and maybe focus on them for the shop update. 

[h2]What about the process?[/h2]

It's been a while since we've shown you anything related to the game creating. Luckily, I saved up some of the sketches to show you! 

It takes time to plan the outfits and design the characters the way we like it, and you guys helped us a lot with choosing some of the important details of the outfits, which added up to the story itself and lead to the whole backround design and backstory for the character.

How long has it been since you went to a local band concert? Join us for this one gig. This band is powered by Love itself... and a bit of beer.

notes.title: Stuffing the box - what's up with Bella?

Elliot is, of course, always here to help his woman, as good future husbands do. However, there's a lot of work to do, and it affects their personal time spent together. notes.title: MORE ABOUT THE UPCOMING STORIES
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Now that the Fool’s Day is over you can take us seriously, no joke. I’m pleased to tell you that the spring discounts are still here - you can get almost all of our[i][b] games and DLCs with a  50% discount[/b][/i]! Now, isn’t it a steal? Enjoy the casual one hand gaming ːls_heartː

I bet you can’t wait for the [b]Sex And The Furry Titty 3[/b] to roll in as soon as possible, and you’re dying to know what’s in our pockets in terms of the stories. I guess it’s time to introduce you to the new plots. Buckle up, we’re rolling into the City!

[h2]Résidence à trois[/h2]

Owning an apartment? In this economy? No, thanks! It’s not your thought, though, you’d rather be the owner than to go through the renting hell again, Yet, here you are - in front of the apartment complex, desperate to find a corner for yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/e5e405fae58c994b44737d6b0c0fae6ab336149d.png[/img]

It just so happens that you’re dumb enough to confuse the buildings and find yourself in front of two gorgeous girls wanting to show you the apartment. And you’re not in the position to stand there and think of the world problems. So, naturally, you take the free spot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/fc4525380be5eca703cc767b5f94a6d7da877621.png[/img]

And the girls are absolutely amazing and a little bit crazy, but it’s fine, as long as you three are in good terms. Will you be able to conquer their hearts with delicious home-made food and a little bit of care for them both? 

[h2]Smells Like Sex Spirit[/h2]

Ashley and Curt dream of becoming the biggest rock stars of all times. They are also hopelessly in love with each other, and none of them knows it. Except for, maybe, their friends who are, by the way, always the first ones to disappear after the practice. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/2af5e31d6061d9a5057eb288c194ee3704b1a387.png[/img]

Curt is kind and cute, and strong and… Ashley really wants him to turn his gaze on her. So, she takes every opportunity to spend more time with him. Gladly, there’s always a lot to do, like cleaning up the garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/6add1a80deb01709b7a87874293682aedb2c7e47.png[/img]

Will be Curt brave enough to finally notice her romantic moves and accept her feelings, or is he just another brick in the wall? Find out in Sex And The Furry Titty 3!
